description:
Elections forecasting agency The Cook Political Report moved 19 House races toward the Democrats in an update this morning that said the chances of a Republican House majority “have all but evaporated.” The elections forecaster said Democrats are now expected to flip between 12 and 22 seats in the House.

“Several of these ratings changes — particularly in Texas and North Carolina — are tied to Republicans’ underperformance at the top of the ticket and the resulting delta between Republican and Democratic voter enthusiasm statewide,” The Cook Political Report said. The forecaster moved six races from “toss up” to “lean Democrat” and two races from “lean Republican” to “toss up.”

author: CNN
description:
The Trump administration has preemptively filed a lawsuit seeking to block certification of Alaska’s US Senate election if the Republican incumbent Sen. Dan Sullivan loses in the state which could decide the balance of power in the Senate. 

The lawsuit represents the latest attempt of the Trump Justice Department to insert itself in the administration of elections, running up against the minimal role the Constitution gives the Executive Branch to unilaterally get involved in running the vote. It alleges that the presence of a candidate named Daniel J. Sullivan could confuse voters and wants a court to potentially delay the certification of the election if Sen. Sullivan is defeated next month. 

CNN's Gabe Cohen has details on the "unprecedented" lawsuit. Also, former federal prosecutor Berit Berger says the DOJ's case has "factual and legal issues," plus political strategists Melik Abdul and Tre Easton give their takes.

0:00 CNN's Gabe Cohen has details on Trump DOJ's lawsuit 
3:29
title: Trump DOJ sues to block AK Senate result if Dem wins

Trump said the contents of the ad were fair game, despite Democrat Amy Acton maintaining she hasn’t spoken to her mother since 1978.
